Ad: Kevin Trudeau tells the story of two men on a porch and an old hound dog that keeps moaning but never moves.

When one man asks why the dog won't get up, the other says he's lying on a nail, but it doesn't hurt him enough.

Kevin says people can be the same. They don't like their house, their car or their situation, but the discomfort never gets big enough to force a change.

A change often starts when staying put hurts more than moving.

What is your version of the nail you keep lying on?

#mindset #motivation #kevintrudeau

Ad: Kevin Trudeau grew up in a blue collar town and wanted to learn how successful people think.

His plan was simple. He became a caddy at a country club where the members were wealthy, and he watched them closely.

He noticed they talked, thought and carried themselves differently. But they were normal human beings, just like his dad.

The real difference was how they thought and how they saw themselves. That is when he realized he could do it too.

Who are you spending your time around?

#success #mindset #kevintrudeau

Ad: Kevin Trudeau grew up in a blue collar community where his dad was a welder and his mom stayed home.

Everyone on the street worked a job, hoped to get into the union and dreamed of a government pension.

Kevin learned early that you have to work for yourself and be your own boss.

That lesson sent him to the library to read about people who became very successful.

What did you learn early about work from the people around you?

#entrepreneur #mindset #kevintrudeau
